description: This source file defines the 'CounterCaptureCommand' class, which extends the command-line interface for capturing and reporting counter metrics from an Orleans cluster. It sets up command-line options, initializes an Orleans client, interacts with a counter grain, and publishes benchmarking data.

classes.name: CounterCaptureCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for capturing counters, initializing Orleans client connection, querying counter grains, benchmarking, and logging results.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating command-line parameters for service ID, cluster ID, URIs, counter key, and list of counters.

methods.name: CounterCaptureCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command options and handler.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that executes the command: connects to Orleans cluster, retrieves counter data, logs, and benchmarks.
